sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 138)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and British networks, Bret Morrison as *The Shadow* solving *The Lively Corpse* for 'blue coal', Groucho Marx emceeing wartime morale extravaganza *Mail Call #53* with Paulette Goddard and Tommy Dorsey, silent screen star Laura La Plante reminiscing on *Little Old Hollywood*, volcanic mayhem aboard HMS Troutbridge in *The Navy Lark*, Walter Tetley and Paul Frees in *Strange*, and Ranger Bill rescuing young Timmy from Mount Evergreen (1940–1973):
